exposure: abnormal fetal umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry
cohort: 146 women with singleton pregnancies in cephalic presentation, induced at or after 36 weeks gestation for suspected FGR and an unripe cervix
finding: Induction of labor for suspected FGR at or after 36 weeks gestation, even with an unripe cervix, is a reasonable option with an acceptable cesarean delivery risk and comparable neonatal outcomes between vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The risk of poor neonatal condition did not differ significantly between women with vaginal and caesarean deliveries.
